pfd.models package

Submodules

pfd.models.bayesian_estimation module

This file estimates the learning rate using Bayesian methods.

pfd.models.bayesian_estimation.estimate_bayesian_learning_rate(df: DataFrame, n_per: int, rmse: Series, cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams, stata_colors: list) → tuple[dict, DataFrame, float, float, float, float, float, float, float][source]

Estimate the learning rate using Bayesian methods.

This function estimates the bookmaker-specific learning rate using ADVI and NUTS, for the total sample as well as favorites/longshots, professionals/amateurs, and a 10x partition by opening odds.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Wide-format, imputed estimation sample.

  • n_per (int) – Number of periods of the time series.

  • rmse (pd.Series) – RMSE of the opening odds for each bookmaker.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

  • stata_colors (list) – Color palette.

Returns:

res_pm, metrics, gamma_med_nuts, gamma_lower_nuts, gamma_upper_nuts, gamma_fav, gamma_udd, gamma_pro, gamma_amat.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.bookmaker_accuracy module

This file analyzes bookmaker accuracy and general price movements.

pfd.models.bookmaker_accuracy.analyze_bookmaker_accuracy(df: DataFrame, exog_cols: list[str], bookies: list[str], cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams, stata_colors: list) → tuple[Series, DataFrame, float, list[str], list[str], DataFrame][source]

Analyze bookmaker accuracy and general price movements.

This function calculates the accuracy of opening odds across bookmakers, general price movements from opening to closing odds, and the relative forecast accuracy of opening vs. closing lines.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Filtered and shaped estimation sample.

  • exog_cols (list[str]) – Exogenous variables.

  • bookies (list[str]) – Bookmakers.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

  • stata_colors (list) – Color palette.

Returns:

rmse, df_oc, iqr_rtrns, tex_res_gpm, tex_res_rfa, df_res_rfa.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.filter_and_shape module

This file filters and shapes the estimation sample.

pfd.models.filter_and_shape.filter_and_shape_data(df: DataFrame, cfg: PFDConfig) → tuple[DataFrame, DataFrame, list[str], list[str], int, int, float, float][source]

Filter and shape the estimation sample.

This function applies the margin/bookmaker/time-series-duration filters, determines favorites/longshots, takes the home or away perspective, and encodes the exogenous variables used throughout the rest of the estimation.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Shaped data as produced by shape_data().

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

Returns:

df, df_desc, bookies, exog_cols, n_obs, n_groups, is_amateur, is_pro.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.gmm_estimation module

This file estimates the learning rate using GMM.

pfd.models.gmm_estimation.estimate_gmm_learning_rate(df: DataFrame, n_per: int, bookies: list[str], cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams, stata_colors: list) → tuple[Series, str, str][source]

Estimate the learning rate using GMM.

This function estimates the bookmaker-specific learning rate using continuously updated GMM (CUE) as well as a first-stage GMM estimate, both via multiprocessing across bookmakers.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Wide-format, imputed estimation sample.

  • n_per (int) – Number of periods of the time series.

  • bookies (list[str]) – Bookmakers.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

  • stata_colors (list) – Color palette.

Returns:

gamma_stats_gmm, idxmin_gamma_gmm, idxmax_gamma_gmm.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.resample_and_impute module

This file resamples the time series and imputes missing prices.

pfd.models.resample_and_impute.resample_and_impute_data(df: DataFrame, exog_cols: list[str], cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams) → tuple[DataFrame, list[str], int, float][source]

Resample the time series and impute missing initial prices.

This function resamples each match/bookmaker time series to a common percentile-time grid using multiprocessing, reshapes the result to wide format, and imputes prices missing due to different opening timestamps across bookmakers.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Filtered and shaped estimation sample.

  • exog_cols (list[str]) – Exogenous variables.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

Returns:

df (wide, imputed), odds_mvt_cols, n_per, frac_missings.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.time_series_diagnostics module

This file analyzes the statistical properties of the time series data.

pfd.models.time_series_diagnostics.analyze_time_series_diagnostics(df: DataFrame, exog_cols: list[str], odds_mvt_cols: list[str], n_per: int, cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams, stata_colors: list) → tuple[float, float, list[str]][source]

Analyze the statistical properties of the resampled time series.

This function computes cross-sectional (squared) returns, tests for stationarity (ADF), inspects the partial autocorrelation function, and fits a GARCH model on the significant lags.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Wide-format, imputed estimation sample.

  • exog_cols (list[str]) – Exogenous variables.

  • odds_mvt_cols (list[str]) – Columns containing the odds movements.

  • n_per (int) – Number of periods of the time series.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

  • stata_colors (list) – Color palette.

Returns:

adf_stat, adf_p, tex_res_garch.

Return type:

tuple

pfd.models.unbiasedness_regressions module

This file estimates the unbiasedness regressions.

pfd.models.unbiasedness_regressions.estimate_unbiasedness_regressions(df: DataFrame, odds_mvt_cols: list[str], cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams) → Index[source]

Estimate the unbiasedness regressions.

This function estimates, for each time increment, whether the price at that increment is an unbiased predictor of the match outcome, using multiprocessing across time increments.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Wide-format, imputed estimation sample.

  • odds_mvt_cols (list[str]) – Columns containing the odds movements.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

Returns:

Time increments (in percentiles) at which the price is not a significantly biased predictor of the match outcome.

Return type:

pd.Index

pfd.models.winning_proportions module

This file analyzes the magnitude and direction of odds movements.

pfd.models.winning_proportions.analyze_winning_proportions(df_oc: DataFrame, bookies: list[str], cfg: PFDConfig, plot_params: PlotParams, stata_colors: list) → tuple[dict[str, DataFrame], list[str], Series, Series, Series][source]

Analyze the magnitude and direction of odds movements.

This function calculates the winning proportions within intervals of opening-to-closing price changes, and estimates the relation between winning rates and the average price movements within those intervals.

  • bookies (list[str]) – Bookmakers.

  • cfg (PFDConfig) – Config parameters.

  • plot_params (PlotParams) – Plotting parameters.

  • stata_colors (list) – Color palette.

Returns:

res_win_props, tex_res_wp_re, bootstr_std, bootstr_low, bootstr_up.

Return type:

tuple
